headline: P1-M bank withdrawal scrutiny suspended
summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas temporarily suspended a policy requiring banks to scrutinize cash withdrawals above P1 million. The suspension runs from November 13 to January 31, 2027, through Memorandum No. M-2026-050.
why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippine central bank and regulator, and its rules on bank transactions affect lenders and their compliance costs.
